_meta.method: Manual visual review — every asset below was opened and inspected individually this session (not a heuristic or uniform default). Coordinates are fractional (0-1, origin top-left).
_meta.coverSafe: true = safe to render with CSS `object-fit: cover` / background-size:cover at any reasonable crop ratio without losing the subject. false = composition has two separated subjects or a full-bleed symmetric/square layout that cover-cropping can amputate; use `contain`/pillarbox or a wider safe-zone margin instead.
_meta.deviceVariants: Only populated where the composition genuinely requires a different crop emphasis per breakpoint (dual-subject or off-center art). Single-subject centered compositions use the same focalPoint at every breakpoint (object-position simply recenters as the viewport's aspect ratio changes).
